translations.en: Had there once been some kind of shop here...?
You found a treasure chest!
On closer inspection, it was unlocked.
You carefully opened the chest's lid.
A scrap of paper lay inside.
"You're number 100!"
A sword and shield in good condition lay carelessly in the passage.
When you picked them up,
you found dried blood on them.
Sensing something ominous,
you left without doing anything further.
You could hear a mysterious voice...
"The most dangerous moment is when you begin to feel accustomed to things.
That is when greater care is needed."
A sign hung from the ceiling.
"Not only will this day never return,
but neither will this very moment."
The sign creaked as it swayed,
looking somehow forlorn...
"God does not play dice."
A rotting wooden sign stood there.
"Not everything you see
is necessarily the truth."
The sign simply stood in silence.
Words were carved into a stone monument.
"A person you will never meet again,
even if still alive,
is no different from the dead..."
Words were written on the floor...
"Courage is needed not only to go forward,
but also to turn back."
A bandage lay on the ground.
The blood soaked into it had already turned blackish,
and the whole thing was covered in sand.
When you looked at one end of the bandage,
you could see that it had been torn off.
Had a wounded adventurer
been attacked by monsters?
"You hold a sword in your right hand,
but what do you hold in your left?"
A bottle lay at your feet.
It was beautifully clear glass.
You could see a rolled-up scrap of paper inside.
You pulled out the cork sealing the bottle
and took out the paper.
"I send this letter to someone
in a foreign land across the sea.
I pray that this bottle reaches you safely..."
There was no explaining why this letter
lay in the labyrinth...
"Always prepare for the worst."
"There is no guarantee that tomorrow will come."
"Hey there!"
You turned at the unexpected greeting
to find an unfamiliar adventurer.
The young man, of average height and somewhat muscular build,
spoke to you.
"Exploring the labyrinth too, are you?
I found an Antidote earlier, but I don't need it.
Would you take it off my hands?"
You obtained an Antidote!
Tap!
Something like a pebble fell onto your head.
The ceiling seemed to be crumbling.
Thud!
This time, something a little larger fell onto your head.
When it landed on the ground, you saw it was a Teleport Scroll.
You obtained a Teleport Scroll!
You found a crude wooden box!
The box was just the right size
for storing supplies.
When you opened the lid of the shabby box,
a Teleport Scroll lay inside.
Though you had driven back the enemy,
the magic circle's murky aura showed no sign of weakening.
Would this magic circle keep pouring out its power forever?
"Even my companion has finally stopped writing on the walls.
There is little conversation now, and every step is heavy."
